description: Original free Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory game data

sources.instructions: Use an original Enemy Territory installation or the upstream FAQ-linked free game distribution. Copy pak0.pk3 to etmain/; pak1.pk3 and pak2.pk3 may be needed by third-party mods. This is separate from the ET: Legacy engine download.

manual_reason: Import requires a complete compatible distribution and manual staging. See assets requirements for this game.
